title: 彭博航天主编：SpaceX IPO时间表与750亿美元募资用途
speaker: Benedict Campbell

segments.en: So that the sequence of events in the next couple of days is that we will get sort of the range that's likely on the 4th of June and then the actual price is fixed on the 10th and then the actual trading starts on the 11th so you're going to see a lot of joking in the next couple of days on this where they'll actually fall but as you said must himself came out with that single word denial if you want to call it that call it false but you know there's still lots of time left it might not seem that much but a lot can happen in the next week.
segments.zh: 接下来几天的时间线：6月4日左右公布价格区间，10日确定最终价格，11日开始交易。未来几天会有很多波动，马斯克本人只用了“假”字否认，但仍有时间，一周内可能发生很多变化。

segments.en: Let me ask you about the 75 billion dollar figure that is how much this company intends to raise and we've we've talked a lot in recent days just about how this company's become something of a conglomerate yes it shoots rockets into the air and has aspirations going to the moon and Mars beyond that but it's also involved in satellites and AI and all manner of things that Elon Musk is interested in.
segments.zh: 关于750亿美元募资额，这家公司已变成多元化集团：发射火箭、登月火星、卫星、AI等马斯克感兴趣的一切。
